name: Bizzabo
description_en:
Bizzabo supports connected event operations spanning registration, tickets and orders, attendee communications, websites, agendas, onsite or virtual participation and analytics. These capabilities are described in its publicly accessible organizer onboarding material, with mobile-app and attendee-help documents adding operational detail.

This profile uses those actual official documents rather than inaccessible marketing pages. Training topics describe workflows, not a promise that every capability is included in one plan. Current software prices, trial availability and commercial package limits remain unknown.
description_zh:
Bizzabo 支持登记、票与订单、参与者沟通、网站、议程、现场或虚拟参与及分析等活动流程。可访问的官方组织者培训资料介绍这些环节，移动手册及参会帮助补充操作细节。

本文依据实读官方文档，不采用不可访问营销页的摘要。培训主题不证明全部功能含于同一套餐，现软件金额、试用及商业上限仍未知。

core_features.explanation_en: Onboarding covers contacts, registration, ticket/order management, email campaigns and agenda setup.
core_features.explanation_zh: 培训涵盖联系人、登记、票/订单、邮件及议程配置。

core_features.explanation_en: The Bizzabo-specific mobile guide describes agenda, messaging, maps and segmented notifications.
core_features.explanation_zh: 移动手册的Bizzabo专属段介绍议程、消息、地图及分组通知。

en: Plan a conference registration-to-session journey with role and ticket checks.
zh: 规划会议从登记到分会访问并核角色/票。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Confirm current contract and plan, configure a nonpublic event and team permissions, then test registration, correct-ticket login and schedule changes before launch.
steps.zh: 确认现合同/套餐，配置非公开活动及团队权限，开放前测登记、正确票登录及日程变化。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current software price and commercial terms are unknown; official pricing/organizer contract returned HTTP 403. No search-summary or third-party amount used.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 现软件价格及商业条款未知；官方价格/组织者合同403，未使用搜索摘要或第三方金额。

sources.title: FAQ | Bizzabo Onboarding Workshop
sources.research_notes_en: Official Bizzabo onboarding workshop FAQ: team permissions, event creation, payment processor, contacts, registration/tickets/orders, emails, website, agenda, onsite/virtual experience and analytics. Training topics do not prove plan inclusion.

sources.title: Bizzabo's Virtual Experience - Attendee Troubleshooting Guide
sources.research_notes_en: Official attendee troubleshooting: confirmation-link login or registration email plus ticket number, not order number; session interest distinct from registration. Old device/browser list not treated as current support.

sources.title: Bizzabo Event App User Guide
sources.research_notes_en: Four-page Bizzabo-hosted mobile-app guide; page four specifically lists Bizzabo app capabilities, distinct from earlier generic app-selection advice. No dated release or plan entitlement established.

sources.title: Bizzabo Customer Data Processing Addendum
sources.research_notes_en: Seven-page official-hosted DPA actually read; controller/processor roles, instructions, retention exceptions and possible extra assistance charges. Contains legacy Privacy Shield and pre-effective GDPR language, so current contract applicability is unverified.

official_check.scope: Public official onboarding HTML, attendee help and two public PDFs actually read. Pricing and current commercial terms not verified. No account, purchase, independent review, hands-on test or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

Pricing intentionally remains not_verified/officially_checked=false. Current shared validator assumes every primary-source-researched profile has checked pricing; do not relabel a DPA as an official price source to satisfy that assumption.

sections.title_en: Reconcile the person, ticket, order and session
sections.title_zh: 对齐人员、票、订单及分会
sections.en: For an illustrative conference, assign team access before configuring contacts, ticket types, registration and the payment processor. Check that the same attendee can find the correct ticket, update the expected record and access only eligible sessions. The onboarding syllabus covers these components but does not document transaction guarantees, refunds, capacity behavior or a full permission matrix. Test those separately before opening registration.
sections.zh: 例如会议，应先配团队权限，再配联系人、票、登记及支付。需核同一参与者找到正确票、对应记录及仅访问合格分会。培训覆盖这些组件，却不说明交易保证、退款、容量或完整权限矩阵，开放登记前需另测。

sections.title_en: Distinguish a saved interest from a registered session
sections.title_zh: 区分收藏兴趣与分会登记
sections.en: The attendee guide requires event registration and a ticket to join virtual sessions. It describes either a confirmation-email link or the registration email plus ticket number, explicitly distinguishing the ticket from an order number. A starred session is an interest marker; the guide uses a separate registration action. For a support case, verify the original registration address and event before changing access. Do not treat the guide’s old operating-system/browser list as current compatibility evidence.
sections.zh: 参会指南要求先登记活动并有票，凭确认邮件链接，或登记邮箱加票号登录，明确票号不同订单号。星标仅兴趣，分会登记另有操作。支持时先核原登记邮箱及活动再改权限；指南旧系统/浏览器清单不作当前兼容证明。

sections.title_en: Choose useful mobile actions and review notification scope
sections.title_zh: 选择有效移动操作并核通知范围
sections.en: The Bizzabo-specific portion of the mobile guide describes an interactive agenda, session chat, questions, feedback/polls, attendee messaging, venue maps and segmented announcements. A practical pilot should check an agenda change, a targeted notification and a consenting attendee connection. Device support, SmartBadge dependencies, custom branding and commercial entitlements must be confirmed for the actual event. The guide’s generic ROI and app-adoption advice is not measured evidence for this product.
sections.zh: 移动手册的 Bizzabo 专属段列互动议程、聊天、提问、反馈/投票、消息、地图及分组通知。试点宜测议程变化、定向通知及同意的联系。设备、SmartBadge依赖、定制品牌及权益需按活动确认，通用ROI/采用建议不是本品测量证据。

sections.title_en: Treat the public DPA as a document to reconcile
sections.title_zh: 将公开 DPA 与当前合同核对
sections.en: The DPA describes customer-controller and Bizzabo-processor roles, processing instructions and notice/consent duties. It also retains backup/legal exceptions to deletion and mentions possible reimbursement for assistance or additional instructions. It is not a software price schedule. Because the document still references Privacy Shield and GDPR taking effect, obtain the applicable current agreement and transfer terms before relying on it. Neither current compliance nor immediate deletion was independently verified.
sections.zh: DPA介绍客户控制者/厂商处理者、处理指令及告知同意，也有备份/法律删除例外、协助或额外指令可能收费。它不是软件价表，仍出现 Privacy Shield及GDPR生效前措辞，采用前须核当前协议和传输条款，未独立确认现合规或即时删除。

sections.title_zh: 商业事实不可访问时保留未知
sections.en: The homepage, pricing, registration marketing route, developer index and organizer agreement returned HTTP 403; none of those denied URLs was retried or bypassed. The knowledge center redirected to login and was not entered. Public onboarding and manuals establish product workflows, but not a software amount, annual commitment, free trial, API quota or cancellation policy. No search excerpt, competitor amount or old brochure was substituted for a verified quote.
sections.zh: 首页、价格、登记营销页、开发者入口及组织者协议返回403，未重试或绕过；知识中心跳登录后未进入。公开培训/手册能说明流程，却不能确立金额、年承诺、试用、API额度或取消规则。未用搜索摘要、竞品金额或旧宣传替代已核报价。

sections.en: Bizzabo merits investigation for a team coordinating several connected event tasks rather than an isolated RSVP. Run an authorized nonpublic pilot covering organizer permissions, registration confirmation, session access, a schedule update and a checked export. The material describes in-platform learning and support routes; no account, copilot, ticket, app, payment, integration or export was executed. Reliability, attendance, engagement and revenue outcomes remain unmeasured.
sections.zh: 团队需连接多种活动任务时可研究Bizzabo，而非仅单独RSVP。建议获授权非公开试点覆盖权限、登记确认、分会访问、日程更新和核导出。资料介绍站内学习及支持，但本文未执行账户、copilot、票、应用、付款、集成或导出，可靠性、参与及收益未测。

research_gaps: Commercial pages HTTP 403 and help center login redirect remain access gaps; no denial was bypassed.
Current software pricing, plan entitlements, trial, renewal, cancellation, API terms and limits remain unknown.
Public attendee/browser and DPA documents have legacy wording; current compatibility, transfer basis, retention and security assurance require confirmation.
No account, registration, payment, mobile app, SmartBadge, copilot, integration, export or outcome tested; source license and self-hosting unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
